title: Put ticfac in the orchestrator image
description:
The image already carries tk, git, Go, ripgrep and a real filesystem, and has /usr/local/bin/ticks-orchestrator as the role entrypoint the Run Workflow starts and streams. It does NOT carry ticfac - zero mentions in image/Dockerfile. That is the gap this epic turns on.

Add the ticfac binary the way everything else in that image is added: pinned and checksummed in the version block at the top, so a rebuild is a diff of that block. Note the image is 'pinned to the tk version it embeds' - ticfac's pin belongs beside it and moves with it.

Nothing else in this tick. Do not change the entrypoint yet.
acceptance_criteria: ticfac is on PATH inside the orchestrator container with its version pinned and checksummed in image/Dockerfile's version block, and 'ticfac version' answers from inside a running container
